title: WS44 generator and digest reconstruction

digest_derivation.canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; keys sorted; separators comma/colon; no insignificant whitespace
digest_derivation.requested_state_digest: SHA-256 of canonical requested-state projection over exact STATE_KEYS
digest_derivation.obligation_digest: SHA-256 of canonical obligation projection over exact OBLIGATION_KEYS
digest_derivation.materialization_digest: SHA-256 of canonical record after removing materialization_digest only
digest_derivation.canonical_bundle_digest: SHA-256 of canonical bundle after removing canonical_bundle_digest only
digest_derivation.materialization_sha256: SHA-256 of persisted canonical bundle bytes including final LF

findings: WS44 v4 is a schema-closure wrapper; it does not independently alter semantic record bytes.
The final semantic assembly and digest lineage are in ws44_build_successor_v2.build.
The successor canonical bundle digest is computed before writing support artifacts and excludes only its own top-level digest field.
The materialization file SHA-256 differs in domain from canonical_bundle_digest because persisted JSON includes the final LF and includes canonical_bundle_digest.
WS47 can therefore perform a bounded one-record requested-state repair while preserving the inherited obligation projection and deterministically recomputing the dependent digest envelope.
